## Funding
AethexAI has raised $3 million in pre-seed [funding](https://afrotech.com/ai-powered-insurance-company-harper) in a round led by 4DX Ventures, Enza Capital, Dorm Room Fund, Mojo Ventures, and Stanford GSB 26 Fund, with angel investors from Stanford faculty also participating, TechCrunch [reports.](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/03/these-two-founders-left-goldman-and-meta-to-build-voice-ai-for-markets-everyone-else-overlooked/) The funding will be used to scale AethexAI's team, improve its [tech,](https://afrotech.com/reducify-launches) and deploy more voice agents.
